messages:
Ana Rivera: FYI — customer (acct_8921) reports they can't start free trial because our checkout requires card-on-file and their 3DS auth keeps failing. They see: 'authentication_required' + ACS returned error. They expect promo code to work without card.
Marcus Chen: Ack. Do we allow trials without card? I thought our flow requires a card for fraud reasons in EU.
Ana Rivera: Right, policy is card-on-file required, but product promised promo to a partner program. Partner flagged this as blocker. Customer is in DE, issuer returns `3DS:failed` on first auth attempt.
Priya Singh: Can you paste the gateway logs and the exact error code? We need to see if it's an ACS timeout or an issuer decline.
Ana Rivera: Logs:
```
payment_intent: pi_5a9f
3ds_result: failed
acs_response: NETWORK_ERROR
auth_code: null
attempts: 1
country: DE
```
Marcus Chen: Hmm looks like network timeout to the ACS. Could be customer's bank or our 3DS provider timing out. What was the device/browser?
Ana Rivera: Chrome 110 on mobile, tried both wifi and cell. Customer tried again and got a different error: `3DS_NOT_SUPPORTED`.
Eve Patel: If issuer doesn't support 3DS we still shouldn't block trial grants if partner promo says so. We can manually grant credits from the Billing Admin UI — but need approvals for bypassing card requirement.
Ana Rivera: Customer asked for immediate workaround, they can't wait. Can we give a one-off trial grant and mark as manual verification? They also tried the promo code "PARTNERQ1" which returns "promo_requires_card" from the API.
Priya Singh: Repro steps for devs/payments:
1) Create test acct with country=DE
2) Call POST /v1/checkout/session with payment_method=null and promo=PARTNERQ1
3) Observe response: 402 "payment_required" with body: {"error":"promo_requires_card"}
4) Attempt card entry with test 3DS flow -> simulate ACS timeout -> payment fails

Marcus Chen: Thanks. I'll check our 3DS provider logs (stripe/adyen equivalent) — possible edge case where issuer returns 'not_participating' and provider maps that to failure instead of fallback. If provider can't guarantee fallback, promo logic blocks.
Eve Patel: For now authorized workaround: support can issue 14-day trial credits up to $200 via Billing Admin -> Grants tab. Please include this case ID in the notes and set flag `manual_trial_grant=true`.
Ana Rivera: I'll grant credits after confirmation. Customer wants to avoid storing card; will that impact future billing? We'll set them as trial-only and disable auto-charge.
billing-bot: ACTION: Create credit grant record -> grant_id: g_2026_777 -> amount_usd: 50 -> expires: 2026-04-14 -> admin: Ana.R
Ana Rivera: Done, grant attached to acct_8921, customer notified. Asked partner to whitelist the account so we don't re-request card.
Priya Singh: Engineering follow-up: Marcus, can you open an infra ticket to check 3DS timeouts for DE and provider behavior for non-participating issuers? Tag payments-team and compliance.
Marcus Chen: Will do. Ticket #PAY-3154 opened with initial logs.
Eve Patel: Also follow up with Product on promo UX: if promo can't be applied without card, we should show clearer messaging and offer support link.
Ana Rivera: Closing thread — customer confirmed trial access. Marking as resolved for support, leaving engineering ticket open.
